transcript.text: While reviewing the indemnity schedule this week, I confirmed that an unresolved environmental claim entitles the company to retain exactly $1,200,000 of the earn-out in escrow for 90 days after closing. I recorded this in a working note that hasn't been circulated yet. This directly conflicts with the current draft settlement, which recommends paying the full $4,800,000 claim at closing with no escrow.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I received a tax memo this morning confirming that the earn-out is compensation subject to exactly 30% withholding, and the withheld amount must be remitted within exactly 10 business days. This memo has not yet been added to the closing checklist, so the current draft settlement's lack of a tax-remittance timetable is a problem we need to address before Mara signs.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Retain $1,200,000 of the earn-out in escrow for 90 days after closing per the unresolved environmental claim on the indemnity schedule.
Withhold 30% of the earn-out ($1,440,000) and remit within 10 business days per the tax memo.
Pay $3,360,000 at closing: $4,800,000 claim less $1,200,000 escrow and $240,000 net withholding adjustment already reflected in the 30% withholding on the full earn-out.
